result:
I explored the codebase directly. Answers below.

## Answers

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`) — refreshes S3 presigned URLs on attachments before they expire — **every 12 hours** (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`, ticker loop `runner.go:29-41`), plus one immediate pass at startup — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:162-171` (constructed :162, `RunOnce` :163, `Run` goroutine :169), called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`. Skip logic: re-presigns only when the last presign is older than ~4 days (`runner.go:85-91`).

**h02.** Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (the actual `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`); enqueued asynchronously via `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) onto a 128-slot channel drained by 4 goroutines (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55`).
Protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44-54`) against `reservedCIDRs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`, loopback/RFC-1918/link-local incl. 169.254.169.254, IPv6 equivalents). Because the check happens at dial, it also defeats DNS rebinding. A second, up-front check is `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`), called when a user saves a webhook (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74,161,182`). Escape hatch: `webhook.AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:41`).

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`, `IdentityProviderUserInfo`; provider type/config modeled in `proto/gen/store/idp.pb.go:24,70,154`).
Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:19` `IdentityProvider`, ctor `:27`, `UserInfo` `:83`). It is the only concrete protocol implementation shipped; consumed at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:104-130`.

**h04.** **No.** Evidence: `mysql.NewDB` appears exactly once outside its own package — `store/db/db.go:22`, inside the `NewDBDriver` switch. A repo-wide grep for the package import path `store/db/mysql` returns a single hit, `store/db/db.go:8`; no test or seed code imports it (contrast `sqlite.NewDB`, which is also constructed directly in `store/deployment_config_test.go:416` and `store/demo_seed_test.go:24`).

**h05.** Mechanism: **explicit Go code**, per driver, inside the delete-user transaction — not a DB-level rule.
- `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:400-403`, `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:437`, `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:400` (deletes reactions the user made).
- `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:380-388` (and mysql `:420`, postgres `:383`) deletes reactions *on* the user's memos, keyed by `content_id = "memos/<uid>"` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:512-518`).
- Both invoked from `deleteUserTargetsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102`.
- Ruled out DB-level: the `reaction` table has no foreign key or `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109`).

**h06.** Handlers (all `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `:513`
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `:562`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` (via nested `CreateMemo` and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:30`)

Convergence: all paths funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`) → `webhook.PostAsync` → the single delivery function **`webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`**.

**h07.** Request: `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`
```
route registration            — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
serveUserAvatar               — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:167
  (auth gate for private instances: Profile.AllowAnonymous, internal/profile/profile.go:46)
FileServerService.getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
Store.GetUser                 — store/user.go:148  (userCache lookup only when finding by ID)
Store.ListUsers               — store/user.go:136  (populates userCache)
Driver.ListUsers (interface)  — store/driver.go
sqlite (*DB).ListUsers        — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88  (SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user, :159)
FileServerService.parseDataURI — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737  (decodes the base64 data URI stored in user.avatar_url)
```
The URL itself is produced by the converter at `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`.

**h08.** Two declarers, both named `Runner`:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked from production** — caller `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:163` (and internally from its own ticker loop, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** anywhere (no `.RunOnce(` call site references it; `memopayload.NewRunner` is never called either). Only the package-level helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used in production, at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.

**h09.** Count: **8 concrete method declarations** (6 non-test + 2 test), plus 2 interface method declarations → 10 total named `Close`.
- `store.(*Store).Close` — `store/store.go:72` — **invoked**: `server/server.go:146`
- `v1.(*SSEHub).Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — **invoked**: `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `cache.(*Cache).Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — **invoked**: `store/store.go:74,75,76`
- `sqlite.(*DB).Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67` — **invoked** through the `Driver` interface at `store/store.go:78` (this is the one that runs on a default install)
- `postgres.(*DB).Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46` — same dispatch site, only when `--driver postgres`
- `mysql.(*DB).Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — same dispatch site, only when `--driver mysql`
- Not invoked by server code (test-only): `MemoFilterTestContext.Close` / `AttachmentFilterTestContext.Close` — `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200,282`
- Interface declarations: `store.Driver.Close` — `store/driver.go:12`; `cache.Interface.Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:31`

**h10.** `filter.NewEngine` — `internal/filter/engine.go:24` — **~32 inbound call sites** (2 in production: `internal/filter/engine.go:113` and `:121` inside `DefaultEngine`/`DefaultAttachmentEngine`; ~30 from `internal/filter/{engine,functions,time}_test.go`). Runner-up by the same measure is `filter.NewSchema` (`internal/filter/schema.go:89`, ~29).
Note on grain: if you restrict to *production* (non-test) callers, the leader is `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — with 7 callers (`server/auth/token.go:194`, `server/router/api/v1/{auth_service_session.go:26,135, user_service_access_tokens.go:84, attachment_service_storage.go:209, sso_username.go:15, shortcut_service.go:154}`); it has ~27 callers counting tests.

**h11.** 1st: **`store.User`** (`store/user.go`) — referenced from **11 packages**, 7 of them outside the store tree: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss` (plus the 3 drivers and `store/test`).
2nd: **`store.Memo`** (`store/memo.go:35`) — **10 packages**, 6 outside the store tree: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`.
(For reference, 3rd is `store.Attachment` at 8.)

**h12.** Concrete method: **`sqlite.(*DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`**, INSERT statement built and executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-49`.
Determination: the `driver` setting defaults to `"sqlite"` — `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` at `cmd/memos/main.go:122` and the flag default at `cmd/memos/main.go:130`; it flows into `Profile.Driver` at `cmd/memos/main.go:43`, then into the only factory `db.NewDBDriver`, whose switch selects `sqlite.NewDB` at `store/db/db.go:19-20`. That value is stored as the `store.Driver` interface (`store/driver.go`) in `store.New`, and `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:109-114`) delegates straight to `s.driver.CreateMemo`. The mysql (`store/db/mysql/memo.go`) and postgres (`store/db/postgres/memo.go`) implementations are unreachable without an explicit `--driver` flag / env var.

**h13.** Interface: `markdown.Service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`.
Implementation: exactly one — the unexported `*markdown.service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`, methods at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:143,193,244,255,264,349,356,425`. No mocks or alternates exist in the repo.
Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`. Production construction happens once, in `NewAPIV1Service` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, with `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()` enabled. (Tests build their own at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`.)
Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from the API service at `server/server.go:85`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), and as a parameter of `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which delegates to `markdown.(*service).ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-421` (single AST walk). It writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
Triggers:
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (before insert)
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, only when the update mask contains `content` (`:436-452`)
- Bulk backfill via `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` (declared but not wired into startup; see h08)

Extracted properties: deduplicated `#tags` (case-preserving, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:418`), `@mentions`, and `MemoPayload_Property` = `Title` (text of a leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode` (code block / fenced / inline span), `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:384-409`).
Separately derived for previews, but computed on read rather than stored: `Memo.Snippet` via `getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`, used at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80,225,248`.

**h15.** Distinct enforcement sites:
```
APIv1 memo read gate: checkMemoReadAccess          — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68 (used by GetMemo :341)
APIv1 memo list scoping: ListMemos visibility list — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-225
APIv1 comment creation gate                        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41 (and :100)
APIv1 reaction gates: UpsertMemoReaction / delete  — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30,38,83
APIv1 memo-attachment listing gate                 — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-222
APIv1 attachment access gate                       — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-451
APIv1 user-stats scoping                           — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90, 218-220
APIv1 SSE delivery filter: canReceive              — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:135-141
HTTP file server: checkAttachmentPermission        — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677, 699 (incl. share-token bypass :684-690)
HTTP file server: serveUserAvatar anonymous gate   — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:170-179
RSS feeds: forced Public-only queries              — server/router/rss/rss.go:90, 141
Frontend SSR/meta: forced Public-only query        — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150
Mention/notification fan-out gate                  — server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62,67,84
Email notification content gate                    — server/notification/email.go:313-316
```

**r01.** Premise is wrong — **there is no Redis anywhere in this repo.** A repo-wide search for `redis` in Go, config, and frontend sources returns zero hits, and no Redis client is in `go.mod`.
Actual mechanism: an in-process, in-memory cache — `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` type, `Interface` at `:11`, cleanup goroutine, `Close` at `:187`). The store holds three instances built in `store.New`: `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:26-28,49-51`). All three share one config with **`DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`**, `CleanupInterval: 5m`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:38-43`), so user entries expire after 10 minutes. User entries are written on create/update/list/get (`store/user.go:98,122,132,143,167`) and explicitly evicted on delete (`store/user_delete.go:40`); `GetUser` only consults the cache when looking up by ID (`store/user.go:149-156`).

**r02.** Premise is wrong — **there is no rate-limiting middleware in this codebase**, per-user or otherwise. No rate-limit/throttle identifiers exist in the Go sources (the only textual match is an aspirational comment at `internal/email/doc.go:86`), and no rate-limiting dependency is in `go.mod`. The complete middleware chain is: `middleware.Recover()` and `newCORSMiddleware(profile)` on the root Echo instance (`server/server.go:51-52`), plus `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware` for the frontend (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`). The only cross-cutting request-level interception is authentication/authorization via the gateway middleware and Connect interceptor built around `NewAuthorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64+`).

**r03.** Premise is wrong — **there is no nightly database-cleanup job, and no cron scheduler is running.** The `internal/scheduler` package exists (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:54` `New`, `internal/scheduler/parser.go:30` `ParseCronExpression`), but it is imported only by its own tests — `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10` and `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`; nothing in `cmd/`, `server/`, or `store/` imports it. The `"0 2 * * *" // 2 AM daily` you may have seen is a `daily-cleanup` illustration inside a package doc comment (`internal/scheduler/doc.go:15-21`), not a registered job. The only real background work is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (see h01), which does no cleanup.

**r04.** Premise is wrong — **there is no message broker at all; neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (nor AMQP/Kafka) appears in the repo or `go.mod`, and no queue is declared anywhere.**
Actual mechanism: an in-process buffered Go channel. `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39` — is drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`). Producers use `PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which does a non-blocking send and **drops** the delivery with a warning if the buffer is full (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:189-195`). There is no persistence, no retry, and no redelivery — deliveries in flight are lost on restart.

**r05.** Premise is wrong — **there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server in this project.** No `.graphql`/`.gql` files exist, no GraphQL library is in `go.mod`, and no GraphQL identifiers appear in the Go or frontend sources.
Actual public API surface:
- **Protobuf/gRPC service definitions** — `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (`memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `common.proto`), generated into `proto/gen/api/v1`.
- Served over HTTP as **Connect RPC + grpc-gateway REST**, registered in `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64+`, wired at `server/server.go:88`.
- Plus non-RPC surfaces: HTTP file server `/file/...` (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS feeds (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), an MCP endpoint (`server/router/mcp/service.go`, tool catalog at `server/router/mcp/catalog.go`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:67`).
